title: Lyra Capability Schema
description: Defines a single capability registered by a consumer application, including parameter and response schemas.

id.description: Unique identifier formatted as org.project.capability_name or brand.category.domain.capability_name.

description.description: Detailed description of capability logic for AI intent mapping.

protocol.description: Integration protocol used to execute the capability.

endpoint.description: The URL endpoint or tool name to call.

parameters.description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) describing the input parameters required by the capability.

returns.description: JSON Schema describing the expected response format.

error_codes.description: List of business error codes this capability can return.

x-intendedUse: Authoritative validation of registered capabilities in the Capability Registry.
